review_candidates.title: Intermediate Technical Support Analyst
review_candidates.description: At Journal Technologies, we believe our technology can be a force for good in the world ensuring the proper and efficient functioning of some of the most foundational aspects of society - the courts and justice system. We create and implement enterprise software that supports the administration of justice, currently in the United States, Canada, and Australia. While our eSeries product suite enables governments and their employees to deliver continued foundational court processes, our R&D focuses on leveraging emerging possibilities with technology to improve access and efficiency. Headquartered in Los Angeles, Journal Technologies is a long-time, wholly-owned subsidiary of Daily Journal Corporation (NASDAQ: DJCO). We also have a major office in Logan, Utah, a team in Melbourne, Australia, an office in Victoria, Canada and a growing number of remote staff across North America and the world. Under our next generation of leadership, we're implementing a new vision for the company that prioritizes building an extraordinary workplace with empowered people at the heart of our business. Great people want to collaborate with great people, and we are actively looking for smart, motivated people who care deeply about the work they do. Intermediate Technical Support Analyst We are looking for a Technical Support Analyst to provide technical software support. Effective communication, analytical, and critical thinking skills are required to help our customers resolve technical issues with our products & services. The successful candidate can work independently to solve complex problems while ensuring they provide exceptional customer service. The ideal candidate will enjoy solving a good puzzle and will not be defeated if it takes time to crack the code. Responsibilities Respond promptly to customer support requests via telephone, email, and support portal. Troubleshoot and resolve software and technical issues using established methods; escalate issues when they cannot be resolved within defined guidelines. Track escalated tickets to ensure follow-up and resolution within service level agreements (SLAs). Collaborate with Product and Professional Services staff to provide information that assists in resolving escalated issues. Prioritize, log, and track issues through resolution, ensuring accurate documentation in the support Knowledge Base. Keep customers informed on the status of tickets using approved communication channels, including phone, email notifications, and portal updates. Stay current with product changes and updates by participating in training and reviewing release documentation. Contribute to ongoing process improvements within the support team by identifying recurring issues and recommending adjustments to procedures. Provide after-hours emergency support on a scheduled rotational basis (weekly on-call assignments). Occasionally travel to customer sites to provide support, as assigned. Knowledge, Skills And Abilities Experience providing technical support to remote customers Excellent verbal and written communications skills Ability to manage multiple concurrent tasks Ability to work with internal stakeholders to ensure issue resolution Dedicated commitment to customer success Thrive under constantly changing conditions, offering new ideas and fresh approaches to problems Ability to dig into a complex system to determine the underlying issue, and enjoy solving it Requirements Certificate or Diploma in Information Technology preferred, or equivalent related experience. 2+ years of technical support experience with web-hosted, on-premise, and/or cloud-based software applications. Working knowledge of common platforms such as Java, HTML, and SQL sufficient to support, troubleshoot, and document issues. Familiarity with scripting languages (e.g., Groovy, JavaScript) is a plus but not required. Experience with SQL queries and basic development (PL/SQL, Transact-SQL) to assist in troubleshooting and reporting. Exposure to reporting tools such as Crystal Reports is a plus. Hands-on experience providing support for Java applications, including troubleshooting and maintenance. Familiarity with the justice field and terminology is an asset, but not required. Experience working within Agile teams or formal training in Scrum or Agile methodologies is considered a strong asset. At this time, we are only able to consider candidates who are Canadian or U.S. citizens or permanent residents due to employment authorization requirements. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or work authorization support for this position. Why Journal Technologies? Visit Www.journaltech.com/careers For More Information, But Highlights Include Competitive compensation based on skills, experience, and years of service. Quality medical, dental and vision coverage. Competitive paid time off as well as paid holiday time. 401(k) retirement (US) and GRRSP (CDN) programs. Annual professional development funds - $1,500 USD annual per employee. Book subscriptions with an extensive library in each office for personal and professional growth. Flexible working hours which you can coordinate with your supervisor. Ability for employees to work from a remote location (e.g., home) or office. Personal meetings with direct managers approximately every four to six weeks to discuss career growth and advancement opportunities as well as other issues important to the employees. Travel opportunities between Journal Technology offices and with clients. We provide technology that matters in the world, and we're a stable employer comprised of quality people, with a commitment to investing in our people. The salary range posted for this position, which reflects a good-faith estimate of the base salary we reasonably expect to offer a successful candidate upon hire. Final compensation will be based on job-related factors, including qualifications, experience, geographic location, and internal compensation considerations. The Pay Range For This Role Is 55,000 - 72,000 USD per year(US)

review_candidates.description: Descrição da vaga A Liderteam procura recrutar para a função de Application Support, com capacidade para acompanhar clientes, resolver incidentes, analisar processos e garantir que as aplicações respondem de forma estável às necessidades do negócio. Procuramos alguém com sentido prático, boa capacidade analítica e gosto por resolver problemas. Esta função é essencial para assegurar a continuidade operacional dos nossos clientes, apoiando utilizadores, identificando causas de erros e articulando soluções com consultores funcionais, técnicos e equipas de projeto. O que vais fazer . Prestar suporte aplicacional a utilizadores. . Analisar incidentes, pedidos de apoio e dúvidas funcionais ou técnicas. . Identificar causas de erros e propor soluções estáveis e bem documentadas. . Acompanhar processos de negócio nas áreas RH, financeira, compras, vendas, stocks, produção ou logística. . Apoiar clientes na utilização diária do ERP e na melhoria dos seus processos. . Colaborar com consultores funcionais e técnicos na resolução de situações mais complexas. . Registar, acompanhar e documentar pedidos de suporte até à sua resolução. . Participar em testes, validações e acompanhamento após entrada em produção. . Contribuir para a melhoria contínua do serviço de suporte e da experiência do cliente. O que procuramos . Experiência em suporte aplicacional, consultoria ERP ou funções semelhantes. . Conhecimento de Sage X3 ou de outros ERPs, como Primavera, PHC, SAP, Dynamics ou semelhantes. . Capacidade para analisar problemas, interpretar mensagens de erro e encontrar soluções práticas. . Boa comunicação com utilizadores, clientes e equipas internas. . Organização, autonomia e sentido de responsabilidade na gestão de pedidos. . Orientação para o cliente e capacidade de manter a calma perante situações urgentes. . Interesse por processos de negócio, tecnologia e melhoria contínua. O que valorizamos . Experiência em na função. . Conhecimentos de SQL, bases de dados ou análise de logs. . Experiência em ambientes industriais, logística, distribuição, serviços ou operações multiempresa. . Capacidade para compreender fluxos funcionais e traduzir problemas operacionais em pedidos claros. . Experiência em ferramentas de ticketing ou gestão de suporte. . Conhecimentos nas áreas financeira, stocks, compras, vendas ou produção. . Perfil curioso, rigoroso e com vontade de evoluir tecnicamente. O que oferecemos . Formação e evolução em Sage X3 e soluções complementares. . Participação em projetos nacionais e internacionais. . review_candidates.title: Senior Data Engineer - Telecommunicatie
review_candidates.description: Functiebeschrijving Wil jij als Senior Data Engineer een cruciale rol spelen in de digitale transformatie binnen het zakelijke telecommunicatiedomein? Bij ons krijg je de kans om end-to-end data-engineeringprojecten te leiden en innovatieve oplossingen te creëren die directe impact hebben op de toekomst van de telecomsector. Jouw rol in ons team Als Senior Data Engineer werk je in een agile omgeving samen met een team van specialisten, zoals ontwikkelaars, testers, analisten en data scientists, die voorop lopen in technologische ontwikkelingen. Je houdt je bezig met het ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van datapijplijnen en data-architecturen voor ETL/ELT-processen. Daarbij zorg je voor efficiënte, schaalbare en betrouwbare datastromen die grote hoeveelheden gestructureerde en ongestructureerde data verwerken. Je werkt nauw samen met business stakeholders om technische oplossingen direct te koppelen aan organisatie- en klantdoelen. Met jouw expertise zorg je ervoor dat onze dataoplossingen future-proof zijn en optimaal presteren in een snel veranderende markt. Hoe jij ons versterkt Je bent een gedreven en ervaren Senior Data Engineer die enthousiast wordt van big data, Cloudtechnologie en het voortdurend verkennen van nieuwe tools en frameworks. Je past DevOps- en CI/CD-principes toe om ontwikkelprocessen te optimaliseren, en introduceert proactief nieuwe technologieën om alles naar een hoger niveau tillen. Daarnaast speel je een belangrijke rol in het begeleiden en coachen van junior teamleden, waarmee je bijdraagt aan een lerende en samenwerkende teamcultuur. Dit breng jij mee Een afgeronde technische WO- of HBO-opleiding, met WO-denkniveau. Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in data engineering, inclusief aantoonbare projectleiding. Aantoonbare ervaring in programmeertalen zoals Python, PySpark, Scala, Rust of Java. Ervaring met frameworks en platforms zoals Apache Spark, Databricks, en het ontwerpen van data lakes, datawarehouses en datapijplijnen (o.a. Azure Synapse, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric of vergelijkbaar). Expertise in cloudplatformen zoals Azure, AWS of GCP—met focus op schaalbaarheid en kostenefficiëntie. Ervaring met streamingoplossingen zoals Kafka en Event Hub. Kennis van Kubernetes, Docker, Azure DevOps en CI/CD-principes. Sterke vaardigheden in databasebeheer (SQL en NoSQL) en geavanceerde querying. Ervaring met agile methodieken zoals Scrum. Sterke leiderschapsvaardigheden en ervaring in het begeleiden of coachen van teamleden. Uitstekende probleemoplossende vaardigheden en besluitvaardigheid, ook onder tijdsdruk. Heldere communicatieve vaardigheden, met het vermogen om technische concepten te vertalen naar businesswaarde. Vloeiend Nederlands is een pre (professionele beheersing van zowel Nederlands als Engels is gewenst). Een pre-employment screening maakt onderdeel uit van de sollicitatieprocedure Waarom CGI CGI is een van ’s werelds grootste IT-consultancy bedrijven en werkt aan projecten die het dagelijks leven van miljoenen mensen beïnvloeden. Wij bieden jou: De regie over je eigen carrière, met volop ontwikkelmogelijkheden. Werken in kleine, zelfsturende teams met experts in jouw vakgebied. Direct een vast contract en een uitstekend salaris. Parttime mogelijkheden en flexibele werktijden. De kans om te werken met de nieuwste technologieën. De mogelijkheid om aandeelhouder te worden van CGI. Bij CGI geloven we in diversiteit en inclusie, omdat dit leidt tot betere samenwerking en innovatie. We kijken uit naar jouw bijdrage aan ons team! Ben jij klaar om impact te maken? Solliciteer nu en bouw mee aan de telecomtechnologie van de toekomst! Sluit je aan bij ons team van experts en solliciteer direct! We nemen dan zo snel mogelijk contact met je op! Heb je nog vragen over de inhoud van de vacature, stel ze aan Director Consulting Services Roxanne Krijsman via roxanne.kruijsman@cgi.com Vragen over de sollicitatieprocedure? Neem contact op met Recruitment Business Partner Natrah Pula via 06 11218723 of via Natrah.pula@cgi.com. We werken niet samen met externe recruitment bureau’s. Acquisitie wordt daarom niet op prijs gesteld. Taken en verantwoordelijkheden Criteria Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action. In 1976 opgericht als een familiebedrijf, is CGI vandaag de dag een van de grootste onafhankelijke zakelijke en ICT-dienstverleners ter wereld. Bij ons draait het om ownership, teamwork en respect. Je krijgt de ruimte om al je talenten volledig te ontplooien. Vanaf je eerste werkdag ben je mede-eigenaar van CGI. We profiteren samen van ons succes en je krijgt de kans én verantwoordelijkheid om actief bij te dragen aan de koers en strategie van ons bedrijf. Jouw inzet voegt waarde toe. Je werkt aan innovatieve oplossingen en bouwt aan je netwerk van collega's en klanten. Je hebt toegang tot wereldwijde kansen om je ideeën te realiseren, mogelijkheden te benutten en te profiteren van onze kennis van de industrie en technologische expertise. Ontdek bij ons de mogelijkheden voor jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling en zet de volgende stap in je carrière. Hier staat jouw succes centraal!
